work.title: Wind and Truth
work.author: Brandon Sanderson
work.edition_note: Supplied ebook: eISBN 9781250319173; copyright 2024; back matter identifies First Tor Trade Paperback Edition, 2026. Visual assets not audited.

scope: Targeted primary-text checkpoint. Not an exhaustive book or corpus graph. Proposed node IDs are research IDs, not established production IDs.
gate_policy: SA07 is the existing audit-ledger identifier, not a newly approved runtime work ID. Map it through D08's accepted interface. These claims are attested in Wind and Truth; this packet does not establish their earliest revelation. Do not copy legacy numeric bucket 12 into a per-work prerequisite. Gate each alias, edge, label, snippet and destination field independently.

evidence_policy.shown: The inspected text depicts or explicitly identifies the scoped claim; this does not validate unstated implications.
evidence_policy.reported: A named character, historical memory or estimate supplies the claim; preserve that attribution.

sources.locator: Prologue
sources.scope: Gavilar meets the projected Lord of Scars and recalls Vasher's anti-Light research.

sources.locator: Interlude 1: Kalak
sources.scope: Felt, animated cloth, Ala and instructions to report to Kelsier.

sources.locator: Hoid's consultation about the champions' contract
sources.scope: Hoid reports asking Frost and consulting Frost's unnamed sister through a bone.

sources.locator: Urithiru cistern trial
sources.scope: Hoid supplies an Ashyn stone; Dalinar and Navani test a Connected historical vision and return tether.

sources.locator: Szeth's conversation with Nightblood about its makers
sources.scope: Vasher/Zahel/Warbreaker, Shashara, Honorblades, Yesteel and Vivenna are discussed.

sources.locator: Stoneward monastery confrontation
sources.scope: Szeth kills Rit and recovers Talmut's Honorblade.

sources.locator: Sigzil's Narak planning and successive defensive withdrawals
sources.scope: Prime, Two, Three and Four; Two contains the Oathgate; Four and Three are expendable outer positions.

sources.locator: Venli listens to the ancient stones beneath the Shattered Plains
sources.scope: Stone-memory account of the lost moon and ancient destruction.

sources.locator: Interlude 9: Zahel
sources.scope: Axindweth holds Zahel in an aluminum-lined room; Aviar, Breaths and memory removal.

sources.locator: Interlude 11: Dyel
sources.scope: Demoux, Galladon and Baon visit Dyel's shop; Cusicesh and the Iriali departure.

sources.locator: Interlude 13: Lift
sources.scope: Lift rescues Zahel and the red bird; Zahel identifies a full Feruchemist and discusses training.

sources.locator: Interlude 15: Rysn
sources.scope: Rysn's chair prototypes, Hoid's disguise, two held Dawnshards, and Sleepless.

sources.locator: Kaladin's confrontation with Nale
sources.scope: Initial duel followed by Syl as flute, the Wind, and the retelling of Derethil and the Wandersail.

sources.locator: Tanavast's historical account: other Shards and the Heralds' creation
sources.scope: Kor, Reason/Euridrius, Invention/Chan Ko Sar, Valor/Medelantorius, and requests for help.

sources.locator: Shallan revisits her mother's death
sources.scope: Chana, Nale's remote instructions, Dreder, Testament and the childhood attack.

sources.locator: Tanavast's historical account: Mishram's imprisonment and Honor's rejection
sources.scope: Melishi's trap, consequences, Honor withdrawing, and a portion of Tanavast preserved in the Stormfather.

sources.locator: Shinovar climax: Szeth's Fifth Ideal and separation from his highspren
sources.scope: Szeth chooses his own law, rejects his spren, and Nale's spren uses the word auxiliary.

sources.locator: Shinovar climax: Kaladin's Fifth Ideal and Nightblood's Connection
sources.scope: The Fifth Ideal precedes the new Oathpact; a tether to Ishar and a costly remote connection through Nightblood.

sources.locator: Shinovar climax: Nightblood stops feeding
sources.scope: Szeth and Kaladin are endangered by the drain, which persists after Szeth drops the sword, before Nightblood relents.

sources.locator: Urithiru rooftop climax: Honor, renunciation and Retribution
sources.scope: Dalinar takes Honor, renounces oaths, loses the power; Odium destroys the Stormfather before absorbing Honor.

sources.locator: Shinovar climax and Stormfall: the renewed Oathpact
sources.scope: Kaladin replaces Jezrien; a new Honor spear; ten Heralds protect spren; minds sheltered while souls go to Braize.

sources.locator: Stormfall aftermath: Navani, Oathgates and Retribution
sources.scope: Urithiru protection, Stormlight withdrawal, Cultivation's flight, and the failed absorption of spren.

sources.locator: Stormfall aftermath: Dalinar and the Blackthorn
sources.scope: Dalinar's soul departs; a separate legend-born entity receives memories and agrees to serve Retribution.

sources.locator: Hoid's last meeting with Sigzil on Roshar
sources.scope: Hoid transfers the Dawnshard; Sigzil is sent into Shadesmar as Retribution attacks Hoid.

sources.locator: Stormfall aftermath: the listeners
sources.scope: A new offered Light and a changed pool under Narak.

sources.locator: Hoid awakens in Ulaam's care on Scadrial
sources.scope: Regrowth from preserved cells, Design left on Roshar, unreliable communications and a claimed Taldain message.

sources.locator: Stormfall aftermath: Adolin and the Unoathed
sources.scope: Recovering deadeyes and Blade/Plate use despite loss of ordinary Stormlight.

sources.locator: Months-later Shadesmar scenes: Shallan and Sigzil
sources.scope: Vanished Cultivation perpendicularity, Haka'alaku, Iriali caravan, Vienta's survival and Szeth's former highspren.

sources.locator: Months-later Shadesmar scene: Shallan negotiates through Ala
sources.scope: Kelsier's time estimates, limited truce, Ala's consent and the request to route Olo to Azimir.

sources.locator: Retribution's hidden Kharbranth
sources.scope: Actual inhabitants live in an artificial Spiritual Realm city with altered memories.

sources.locator: Epilogue
sources.scope: Miss Grimes hires Hoid as a Ladrian coachman; finding Valor is his future intention.

sources.locator: Postlude to The Stormlight Archive
sources.scope: Kalak wakes in a protected vision with the Heralds; Kaladin confirms his new role.

sources.locator: Thaylen City debate and Jasnah's subsequent encounter with Taravangian
sources.scope: Fen negotiates; the council votes and Fen ratifies; Taravangian discloses a separate contingent assassination plan.

edges.claim: Gavilar encounters a luminous projected figure, not a demonstrated physical visitor.
edges.constraint: Do not animate a physical Kelsier journey to Roshar.

edges.claim: Gavilar recalls Vasher's work on anti-Light.
edges.constraint: Separate recalled collaboration from a present-scene appearance.

edges.claim: Felt captures Kalak and is later confronted as a Ghostblood.
edges.constraint: Source of Felt's Scadrian identity requires the earlier-work bridge audit.

edges.claim: Animated cloth participates in Kalak's capture.
edges.constraint: Animation is observed; Awakening as the specific method is an inference here.

edges.claim: Felt instructs Ala to report to Kelsier as well as Iyatil.
edges.constraint: Do not collapse all Ghostblood decision makers into one actor.

edges.claim: Ala's earlier apparent captivity conceals her spying; she later consents to work for Shallan.
edges.constraint: Employment is consensual and permits continued reports to Kelsier.

edges.claim: Hoid reports that Frost refused to intervene.
edges.constraint: A reported conversation is not a physical cameo.

edges.claim: An unnamed sister of Frost assists with interpreting the contract.
edges.constraint: Keep her unnamed; do not infer identity from other female dragons.

edges.claim: Hoid supplies an old Ashyn stone to connect a controlled vision to the past.
edges.constraint: Does not establish physical time travel or editable history.

edges.claim: Szeth explicitly identifies Zahel as Vasher.
edges.constraint: Alias reveal must be field-gated outside the WaT reading state.

edges.claim: Nightblood uses Warbreaker as a name for Vasher.
edges.constraint: This is an alias claim; link to the book only with separately reviewed bridge metadata.

edges.claim: Nightblood attributes its creation to Vasher and Shashara.
edges.constraint: Preserve attribution to Nightblood.

edges.claim: Nightblood discusses Vasher's part in its creation.
edges.constraint: Do not treat Nightblood's imprecise recollection as an exact dated chronology.

edges.claim: Nightblood says the makers saw Honorblades and sought to make a comparable weapon.
edges.constraint: This is a reported design connection, not proof that Nightblood is an Honorblade.

edges.claim: Vivenna is named in the conversation.
edges.constraint: No Azure/Vivenna physical cameo was established by this checkpoint.

edges.claim: Yesteel is referenced in the makers discussion.
edges.constraint: No physical appearance or active role established.

edges.claim: Szeth recovers Talmut's blade from Rit at the Stoneward monastery.
edges.constraint: Do not invent the identity of the earlier thief from Szeth's reconstruction.

edges.claim: Axindweth confines Zahel, controlling access to clothing and Breaths.
edges.constraint: The aluminum room's demonstrated effect is bounded to this scene.

edges.claim: A green Aviar accompanies her.
edges.constraint: Do not equate it with another named character's bird without evidence.

edges.claim: Zahel identifies the opponent rescued-from by Lift as a full Feruchemist.
edges.constraint: Attribute the technical identification to Zahel; no invented metalmind inventory.

edges.claim: Lift rescues the caged red bird while freeing Zahel.
edges.constraint: Other-book names, prior owner and exact powers remain separate bridge claims.

edges.claim: Lift frees Zahel and asks how to begin training.
edges.constraint: Do not mark an entire subsequent training curriculum completed.

edges.claim: Demoux appears by name in Dyel's shop in Iri.
edges.constraint: Mistborn bridge and earliest reveal require separate per-work mapping.

edges.claim: Galladon appears by name with Demoux and Baon.
edges.constraint: Do not require reading Elantris merely to show a name given in WaT.

edges.claim: Baon appears by name; Dyel initially mistakes him for Nale.
edges.constraint: Baon and Nale are distinct nodes, never aliases.

edges.claim: Galladon cracks a Stormlight sphere and forms symbols.
edges.constraint: The event does not establish unrestricted interchangeability of all Investiture.

edges.claim: The interlude connects Dyel's family and shop to Ym.
edges.constraint: Prior-book scene details remain separately gated.

edges.claim: Cusicesh facilitates the next stage of the Long Trail.
edges.constraint: No final destination world is identified in this scene.

edges.claim: Hoid and Rysn both presently hold Dawnshards at their meeting.
edges.constraint: Hoid is not merely carrying residual effects in this scene.

edges.claim: Their proximity creates a dangerous attempted convergence that Hoid halts.
edges.constraint: Do not invent damage radii, merger recipes or guaranteed controllability.

edges.claim: Nikli and Alalhawithador participate in the scene.
edges.constraint: Preserve distinct individuals instead of a single all-knowing Sleepless character.

edges.claim: Kaladin uses the story during his attempt to reach Nale after fighting him.
edges.constraint: Prior telling, wording and earlier-work gate require separate comparison.

edges.claim: Syl takes instrument form during the Nale encounter.
edges.constraint: The later Honor spear is a separate object.

edges.claim: Tanavast's account depicts his relationship with Kor.
edges.constraint: Keep memory-time separate from the contemporary world state.

edges.claim: Tanavast names Euridrius as Reason's holder.
edges.constraint: Disappearance in that recollection is not proof of death or current location.

edges.claim: Tanavast names Chan Ko Sar with Invention.
edges.constraint: No unsupported homeworld or map coordinates.

edges.claim: Tanavast describes Valor's holder as a great dragon and cannot find her.
edges.constraint: His speculation about death is not confirmation.

edges.claim: Tanavast recounts seeking help from Leras, Ati, Edgli, Bavadin and Chan Ko Sar.
edges.constraint: Show this as his historical account, not a present alliance.

edges.claim: Shallan's childhood vision identifies her mother as the Herald Chana.
edges.constraint: Chana's belief that Shallan inherited the Oathpact is a delusion, not a magic rule.

edges.claim: A seon relays Nale's order; Dreder is physically present.
edges.constraint: Do not put Nale physically in the Davar household.

edges.claim: The scene distinguishes Testament from Pattern and depicts Shallan's childhood bond rupture.
edges.constraint: Do not collapse her two spren into one alias.

edges.claim: Tanavast's account links his deception, Melishi's trap and catastrophic consequences.
edges.constraint: A limited future shown to Radiants was presented as certain; do not repeat that certainty.

edges.relation: partial soul and memories preserved in
edges.claim: A portion of Tanavast is preserved in the Stormfather.
edges.constraint: The Stormfather is not simply the whole surviving human Tanavast.

edges.claim: Szeth separates from his highspren after his Fifth Ideal.
edges.constraint: Do not portray the later spren conversation with Sigzil as already a completed new bond.

edges.claim: Kaladin speaks the Fifth Ideal before becoming a Herald.
edges.constraint: Keep this event; the later Herald oath does not replace it.

edges.claim: Nightblood draws remotely on Kaladin while Szeth wields it.
edges.constraint: Dropping the sword does not immediately end this exceptional drain.

edges.claim: Szeth uses Lashings through the exceptional connection involving Nightblood.
edges.constraint: Do not grant every Surge or a cost-free permanent power set.

edges.claim: Dalinar takes Honor before renouncing his obligations.
edges.constraint: A time-indexed holder record; never replace the entire historical holder list.

edges.claim: Odium destroys the Stormfather before taking Honor.
edges.constraint: Sequence is important.

edges.claim: Honor and Odium combine under Taravangian.
edges.constraint: Combined state does not imply identical behavior to Harmony.

edges.claim: Kaladin becomes the replacement Herald in the renewed pact.
edges.constraint: Distinct from his Windrunner Fifth Ideal.

edges.claim: Retribution cannot draw in the protected spren after the renewed oath.
edges.constraint: Do not promise all forms of harm or future destruction are impossible.

edges.claim: Urithiru is an exception to the general loss of ordinary Stormlight access.
edges.constraint: Location-specific state; Navani and the Sibling are incapacitated.

edges.claim: The nascent legend/spren draws on Dalinar's memories but is distinct from his departed soul.
edges.constraint: Never label this Dalinar resurrected or Dalinar's soul enslaved.

edges.claim: The separate entity accepts service to Retribution.
edges.constraint: Do not make this relationship apply to the Dalinar person node.

edges.claim: Hoid entrusts the Dawnshard to Sigzil and sends him into Shadesmar.
edges.constraint: Later Nomad identity and mechanics require The Sunlit Man bridge audit.

edges.claim: Listeners receive a new offered Light in the changed world.
edges.constraint: No universal equivalence to Stormlight or unconditional future supply implied.

edges.claim: Hoid regrows from the largest surviving portion, a maintained cell culture on Scadrial.
edges.constraint: Not ordinary travel and not a general mechanism available to all characters.

edges.claim: Design remains on Roshar; Hoid senses his powers but cannot summon her as a Blade at this distance.
edges.constraint: Do not say Design left Roshar in this scene.

edges.claim: Ulaam believes a message comes from Taldain and reports Autonomy moving.
edges.constraint: The reported crisis is not a completed future invasion.

edges.claim: Hoid uses a bone and seeks insight from ancient dead in a dragon meditative realm.
edges.constraint: Do not merge this locale with Shadesmar or assert a universal Beyond geography.

edges.claim: Recovering deadeyes and the Unoathed use Blade and Plate after Stormfall.
edges.constraint: Not proof all deadeyes recover instantly or all Radiants regain power.

edges.claim: Cultivation leaves and the familiar perpendicularity is gone.
edges.constraint: Keep its pre-Stormfall existence visible in earlier-era views.

edges.claim: Sigzil learns Vienta recovered but will not reunite with him.
edges.constraint: Do not mark Vienta permanently dead.

edges.claim: The spren confirms it formerly bonded Szeth and rejects its old name.
edges.constraint: Auxiliary identity is a bridge hypothesis until The Sunlit Man is directly reconciled.

edges.claim: Kelsier agrees a personal truce through Ala.
edges.constraint: Not blanket peace between every Ghostblood and Lightweaver.

edges.claim: He estimates roughly seventy to eighty outside years versus about a decade on Roshar before realignment; rate is changing.
edges.constraint: Not an exact constant 8:1 law; uncertainty must remain visible.

edges.claim: Shallan asks Ala to send Olo to Azimir to restore contact with Adolin.
edges.constraint: Request is not confirmed arrival or a completed call.

edges.claim: Real people survive in a manufactured Spiritual Realm city with edited memories.
edges.constraint: Distinguish the destroyed physical city, real people and artificial setting.

edges.claim: Miss Grimes hires Hoid in the epilogue.
edges.constraint: Specific cross-novel callbacks and exact Scadrian chronology remain separate checks.

edges.claim: Hoid plans to find Valor after addressing Scadrial's crisis.
edges.constraint: Do not render a meeting or alliance as already completed.

edges.claim: The Heralds gather in a protected vision while the new pact operates.
edges.constraint: Not a newly mapped physical beach, nor an assurance of permanent safety.

edges.claim: Fen negotiates; the council votes and she ratifies the decision.
edges.constraint: Do not attribute the polity's entire constitutional action to Fen alone.
